title: console: API key Revoke and Restore toasts name no key ("API key revoked")
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVkGJizGH7raJHhAvL

Filing gate: ① a user-visible defect against the write-feedback convention ruling (C on #25849: a record-level success message names the record or gives a count), found by a QA run (off-clause probe, RUNNER rule 8).

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase. Sign in as any user and open Account → Integrations (API keys). Mint a key named "QA key".
2. Use the row action "Revoke API Key". The network shows `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_api_key/ID {"revoked":true}` 200.
3. Use the row action "Restore API Key". The network shows `PATCH … {"revoked":false}` 200.
4. Expected: the toasts name the key, e.g. `API key "QA key" revoked`.
5. Actual: "API key revoked" and "API key restored", the object-only shape that #26459 removed from the showcase task actions.

## Mechanism
`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-api-key.object.ts` ~L161 declares `successMessage: 'API key revoked'` (and the restore sibling) with no `{{ record.name }}` hole.

QA-source: #27441 · identity-auth.api-key-ui-lifecycle · observed beside the clauses
